name: createShort
label: Create a Short
description: Creates an original Short from a topic: script, voiceover, visuals and captions. Uses 1 Short credit.

expect.name: topic
expect.label: Topic
expect.help: What the Short is about, e.g. 'why octopuses have three hearts' (3–300 characters).

expect.name: angle
expect.label: Angle
expect.help: Optional take or framing for the script.

expect.name: length_seconds
expect.label: Length
expect.help: How long the Short should be: 30, 45 or 60 seconds.

expect.name: tone
expect.label: Tone
expect.help: How the narration should sound, e.g. curious, upbeat, serious.

expect.name: caption_style
expect.label: Caption Style
expect.help: How captions look on the video.

expect.name: image_style
expect.label: Image Style
expect.help: Look for AI images: photoreal, cinematic, 3d, hand-drawn, whiteboard, storyboard or anime.

expect.name: voice_id
expect.label: Voice
expect.help: Narrator voice. Leave empty for your default voice.

expect.name: channel_voice_id
expect.label: Channel Voice
expect.help: Write the script in the learned voice of one of your connected channels.

expect.name: topic_id
expect.label: Brief Idea ID
expect.help: The Topic ID from a New Brief Idea trigger, so the idea drops out of later briefs.

samples.next: Wait for the job, then review and approve the Short in ShortLoop.
